relacionamentos.significado: A person you have a strong romantic attraction to, an interest in, or a platonic infatuation with.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I saw my crush at school today and got too shy to talk to him.
exemplos_incorretos: My crush is my childhood best friend's nickname.
We text flirty messages every night, but he's just my crush.
We've hooked up three times, but he's still just my crush, nothing serious.
significados_incorretos: An affectionate nickname used between close friends.
Someone you exchange flirty texts with, no strings attached.
Someone you've hooked up with a few times without committing to anything.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it just names a spontaneous feeling of attraction, without carrying moral judgment or offensive connotation.

relacionamentos.significado: Someone you have frequent conversations or casual, flirty meetups with, with no formal commitment.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I'm not going out with the group today, I'm meeting up with my talking stage.
exemplos_incorretos: I ran into my childhood talking stage at the neighborhood fair.
He's just my talking stage on Instagram, we've never actually talked.
My talking stage from years ago turned into a serious relationship, we just broke up recently.
significados_incorretos: A childhood friend you ran into again recently.
Someone you follow on social media but have never spoken to.
Someone you had a serious relationship with in the past.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Classified as neutral because it describes a common type of casual involvement, without assigning blame or credit to whoever is in that situation.

relacionamentos.significado: A romantic or social meetup between two people, usually meant to get to know each other better or build a romantic relationship.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I went on a date last night and we went to a great restaurant.
exemplos_incorretos: I set up a date with my boss to discuss the project at seven at night.
We all went on a date with the whole crew from work, no romantic vibe at all.
We set up a date just to check in on the relationship, it was pretty serious.
significados_incorretos: A work meeting scheduled at an unusual time.
A group outing with several friends with no romantic intention.
A quick meeting just to decide the status of the relationship.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive impact because it names a moment of connection and care between two people, associated with good expectations and attention to appearance/behavior.

relacionamentos.significado: To be left waiting for someone who never shows up to a date, or to be ignored on social media.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I waited for her at the movies for two hours, I ended up getting stood up.
exemplos_incorretos: I stood up from the couch to answer the door.
Stand-up is a genre of comedy where a person tells jokes on stage.
I waited for his reply all afternoon, I thought I'd get stood up.
significados_incorretos: Physically rising from a seated position.
A comedy performance style done on stage.
Waiting a long time for a text reply without the date being canceled.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes an attitude of disrespect and disregard for the time and feelings of the person who was waiting.

relacionamentos.significado: Short for 'Define The Relationship.' The moment a couple has a serious conversation to resolve conflicts, align expectations, or check the status of the relationship.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: We had a heavy DTR last night, but we managed to work things out.
exemplos_incorretos: I went to the doctor for a check-up because I wasn't feeling well.
We had a chill DTR just to plan the weekend trip.
We had a serious DTR about how we'd split the apartment bills.
significados_incorretos: An abbreviation used to refer to an on-call doctor.
A light conversation about weekend plans with your partner.
A discussion about splitting bills and finances as a couple.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because, although it's a necessary conversation, the term tends to come up associated with tension, wear-and-tear, and the risk of the relationship ending.

relacionamentos.significado: Someone who shows romantic interest in, or deliberately gets involved with, a friend's partner.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: He hit on his best friend's girlfriend, he was being such a snake.
exemplos_incorretos: The snake planned my cousin's entire wedding.
He's a snake, he's always introducing his single friends to each other.
That snake keeps flirting with random strangers at the party.
significados_incorretos: Someone who plans weddings professionally.
A friend who's always setting single people up with each other.
Someone who flirts openly with strangers at parties, with no tie to any friend.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes someone acting disloyally, trying to get involved with a friend's partner, hurting trust and loyalty.

relacionamentos.significado: Someone who watches or admires another person from a distance, without getting directly involved or openly declaring their feelings.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: Maria, your secret admirer Pedro is right there.
exemplos_incorretos: The building's secret admirer watches the security cameras all night.
She's a secret admirer, she only follows celebrities on Instagram and never comments.
He sent a sneaky text asking if I was single, what a secret admirer.
significados_incorretos: A professional who works watching security cameras.
Someone who follows celebrity profiles on social media.
Someone who texts to discreetly find out if you're single.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a discreet, admiring stance from a distance, with no intention to harm anyone nor any invasive action.

relacionamentos.significado: Someone you have a recurring physical and emotional involvement with, that hasn't turned into an official relationship yet.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: We're not seriously dating, he's just my hookup.
exemplos_incorretos: I hired a hookup to be my plus-one at my cousin's wedding.
We met last week on the app, he's my new hookup.
He used to be my boyfriend, now he's just my old hookup, we broke up a while ago.
significados_incorretos: Someone hired to accompany you to formal events.
Someone you recently met on a dating app.
Someone you used to date but broke up with.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Neutral since it names a common intermediate stage of romantic involvement among young people, without passing judgment on whether it's right or wrong.

relacionamentos.significado: A single person who tags along with a couple on an outing or social event, feeling out of place or like they don't belong.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I went to the movies with my friend and his girlfriend and was a third wheel the whole film.
exemplos_incorretos: The third wheel organized a surprise romantic dinner for the couple.
That third wheel always cancels plans last minute, nobody trusts them.
I just went to give the couple advice, I became like a consultant third wheel.
significados_incorretos: Someone who organizes romantic dinners for couples.
A friend who always cancels plans at the last minute.
Someone who tags along with a couple just to give relationship advice.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it portrays a situation of awkwardness and social exclusion, highlighting the discomfort of feeling unwanted.

relacionamentos.significado: To root for or support a couple, whether in real life or fiction, wanting them to get together.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I started shipping those two characters hard in the show.
exemplos_incorretos: We shipped a surprise engagement party for our friends.
After the fight, they shipped and made up quickly.
I kept trying to ship my two single friends, I introduced them at a party.
significados_incorretos: Organizing a surprise engagement party for friends.
Making up with your partner after a fight.
Introducing two single people hoping they'll get together.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it expresses genuine support and rooting for a couple's happiness, whether in real life or fiction.

relacionamentos.significado: To suddenly cut off contact in a romantic or social relationship, with no warning or explanation.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: We were talking every day and, out of nowhere, he ghosted me.
exemplos_incorretos: He ghosts me, he only answers messages in the middle of the night.
We ghosted, we ended things in a clear and calm conversation.
After vanishing for three months, he ghosted his way back into my life like nothing happened.
significados_incorretos: The behavior of only replying to messages late at night.
Ending a relationship in person, with a clear conversation.
Suddenly reappearing after months of silence, like nothing happened.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes cutting off contact abruptly and without explanation, causing confusion and emotional distress in the person left behind.

relacionamentos.significado: To shower someone with intense, exaggerated affection and attention early in a relationship in order to manipulate or keep them interested, often without healthy intentions.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: He sent me flowers every day the first week, but later I realized it was just love bombing.
exemplos_incorretos: He did a love bombing on the stadium jumbotron to propose to her.
We exchanged love bombing gifts on our one-year anniversary.
At first he was affectionate in a balanced way, no exaggerated love bombing.
significados_incorretos: A public declaration of love made in a football stadium.
Exchanging symbolic gifts on a dating anniversary.
Showing genuine, balanced affection early in a relationship.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes emotional manipulation, where an excess of early attention is used as a tool to emotionally trap the other person.

relacionamentos.significado: A male considered attractive, stylish, or interesting in a romantic sense.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: Did you see that cutie who just joined our class?
exemplos_incorretos: My cousin's cutie was born last week, seven pounds.
She's dating a cutie much younger than her.
That cutie doesn't work or study, he still lives with his parents.
significados_incorretos: A nickname used for newborn baby boys.
A younger guy that someone is dating.
An immature guy who still lives with his parents and doesn't work.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive since it lightly compliments a guy's looks or style, without any offensive intent.

relacionamentos.significado: An affectionate term for a couple that shows a lot of affection and closeness in public or in an exaggerated way.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: There go the lovebirds holding hands again, so cute.
exemplos_incorretos: The lovebirds are twins, nobody can tell them apart.
The lovebirds are honeymooning in Fernando de Noronha this week.
Those two are lovebirds, they're always together but swear it's just friendship.
significados_incorretos: A nickname for identical twins.
A newlywed couple on their honeymoon.
Inseparable friends who are always together with no romance involved.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it fondly and humorously describes a couple's public display of affection.

relacionamentos.significado: Slang used to describe someone significantly younger than their partner in a relationship, as a humorous metaphor for their young age.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I didn't know Juliana was into a toyboy, now she's living with that 19-year-old.
exemplos_incorretos: The family's toyboy was born last year, he's already walking.
He's a toyboy, still in college and living with his parents.
Her toyboy seems much older based on how he acts.
significados_incorretos: An affectionate nickname the family gives to a baby.
Someone still in college who lives with their parents.
A younger person who seems more mature than their actual age.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Depends on context because it can be a light joke among friends about an age gap, but it can also sound demeaning depending on tone and intent.

relacionamentos.significado: A relationship where two people are friends but also keep a physical or sexual intimacy without romantic commitment.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: They're not dating, they've just been friends with benefits for years.
exemplos_incorretos: The group's friends with benefits thing is always wearing matching outfits to parties.
Our friends with benefits goes back to kindergarten.
It's a serious relationship disguised as friends with benefits so her parents don't find out.
significados_incorretos: A group of friends who wear matching colorful outfits.
A long friendship that dates back to childhood.
A serious relationship disguised as a friendship so parents don't suspect.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it describes a consensual arrangement between two people who understand and respect agreed-upon boundaries, with no broken promises.

relacionamentos.significado: Blend used to describe a couple who are dating but live together and have a married-like routine, even without making it official on paper.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: We've lived together for five years, we're basically shacking up like a married couple.
exemplos_incorretos: They called the groom 'shacking up' throughout the whole wedding ceremony.
My partner and I are shacking up, but we each still have our own apartment.
We're officially shacking up now, we got married at the courthouse last month.
significados_incorretos: A nickname given to the groom during a wedding ceremony.
A partner who lives alone, without sharing a home with anyone.
An officially married spouse, legally wed.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it fondly describes the day-to-day closeness and routine typical of a committed couple, even without making it official.

relacionamentos.significado: Someone who gets attached very quickly, shows intense feelings, or plans the future early on in a flirtation or relationship.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I met him yesterday and he already wants to introduce me to his parents, he's really catching feelings.
exemplos_incorretos: She's catching feelings, she cries at any romantic movie we watch.
I was catching feelings before the first date, super nervous.
He was catching feelings in the right way, at the right pace, no rush at all.
significados_incorretos: Someone who cries easily watching romantic movies.
Someone who's nervous before a first date.
Someone who shows genuine interest at the right pace from the start.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Depends on context because it can be used to criticize someone rushing their feelings, but also understandingly, simply acknowledging emotional intensity.

relacionamentos.significado: To make small talk with the intention of flirting, seducing, or winning someone over using charm.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: He spent the whole party trying to sweet-talk me, but I didn't fall for it.
exemplos_incorretos: The mechanic sweet-talked the engine to get it started.
I just sweet-talked him with a sincere compliment, no romantic intention.
He sweet-talked her straight up, asked her out with no hesitation.
significados_incorretos: Getting a car engine to start through mechanical work.
Giving a sincere compliment to a friend with no romantic intention.
Asking someone out directly, with no hesitation.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Neutral because it describes a common flirting tactic based on smooth talking, without necessarily indicating bad intentions.

relacionamentos.significado: To be directly rejected by someone you were romantically interested in.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I went to ask the girl out and ended up getting shot down.
exemplos_incorretos: I got shot down by paintballs at the arena last weekend.
I got shot down an hour late, so I missed the date.
I texted her and got shot down, she still hasn't even seen it.
significados_incorretos: Being hit by paintballs during a game.
Arriving an hour late to a scheduled date.
Being ignored on social media after sending a message.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes the experience of direct rejection, an uncomfortable and emotionally frustrating moment for the person turned down.

relacionamentos.significado: Slang for cheating on a romantic partner with someone else.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: The marriage ended after they found out he kept stepping out on her.
exemplos_incorretos: He stepped out to cheer for the rival team after the loss.
They stepped out of the relationship out of nowhere, broke up without warning.
He didn't really cheat, he just stepped out flirting with others on Instagram.
significados_incorretos: Switching to support a rival sports team mid-season.
Suddenly ending a relationship.
Flirting with other people without physically cheating.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it directly names an act of betrayal, breaking trust and commitment within a relationship.

relacionamentos.significado: A warning sign in someone's behavior indicating that person may be toxic, manipulative, or untrustworthy in a relationship.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: She talks trash about every single ex, that's a huge red flag to me.
exemplos_incorretos: The driver saw the red flag and stopped the car on the racetrack.
I found it odd, but it's not really a red flag, just a funny habit of his.
To me that was a good red flag, it shows he's super stable.
significados_incorretos: A flag used to signal danger in Formula 1 races.
A strange but harmless habit of a partner.
A positive sign that shows someone is reliable and stable.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it warns about toxic or harmful behaviors, working as a risk signal to avoid in a relationship.

relacionamentos.significado: To have style, attitude, charm, or a lot of confidence, making someone very attractive or 'cool.'
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: No doubt about it, that guy knows how to dress and talk, he's got sauce.
exemplos_incorretos: I went to the kitchen to make sauce for dinner's pasta.
He only wears expensive brand-name clothes, he thinks that means he's got sauce.
He's got sauce because he always picks up the whole check on dates.
significados_incorretos: Preparing a pasta dish with a special sauce.
Wearing expensive, brand-name clothes on any occasion.
Having enough money to pay for everything on a date.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it compliments someone's confidence, style, and charisma, used as recognition and admiration.

relacionamentos.significado: Someone you had a casual involvement with in the past, but no longer have any romantic or physical relationship with.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I ran into my ex-hookup at the club and pretended I didn't even know him.
exemplos_incorretos: My ex-hookup from the flea market is an old piece of furniture I finally sold.
My ex-hookup is a childhood friend I haven't seen in ten years.
That was my ex-hookup, we dated seriously for two years before breaking up.
significados_incorretos: An old piece of furniture stored away for years.
A longtime friend you haven't seen in years.
Someone you seriously dated in the past.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it refers to a connection that ended, often carrying memories of frustration or emotional wear.

relacionamentos.significado: A hookup you have an almost exclusive relationship with, who acts like a boyfriend/girlfriend (going out, being affectionate, meeting friends), but still without the official label.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: We travel together and talk every day, he's not just a hookup, we're exclusive.
exemplos_incorretos: I signed up for the exclusive plan on the app to get more features.
We're exclusive, but he only sees me on special occasions like birthdays.
He's already my boyfriend, we're exclusive, I just haven't introduced him to my parents yet.
significados_incorretos: A paid subscription plan on a dating app.
Someone who only meets you on special occasions.
An official boyfriend you haven't introduced to your parents yet.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it describes a close, high-quality emotional involvement, with attention and affection similar to an official relationship.

relacionamentos.significado: Creating a fake identity online, using other people's photos and information, usually to romantically deceive someone.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: She thought she was dating a European model, but it was all catfishing.
exemplos_incorretos: I went fishing with colorful catfishing bait at the river this weekend.
She just uses a filter on her profile photos, but it's really her, is that catfishing?
He only lied about his age on his profile, is that already catfishing?
significados_incorretos: A fishing technique using colorful artificial bait.
Using a camera filter on profile photos.
Lying about small personal details, like age or height, on a profile.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes an identity scam used to emotionally deceive another person, involving bad faith.

relacionamentos.significado: When things cool off or someone ghosts you, but they keep orbiting your online life: viewing stories, liking and reacting to posts, but never actually messaging.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: He disappeared from texting, but he's still orbiting my Instagram stories every day.
exemplos_incorretos: In physics class, we learned about the planets orbiting the sun.
He was orbiting by liking all my old photos at once.
After disappearing for three months, he suddenly reappeared, orbiting.
significados_incorretos: An astronomical phenomenon studied in physics class.
Liking all of someone's old profile photos at once.
Suddenly reappearing after months of total silence.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes an ambiguous, uncomfortable attitude of someone who disappears from direct contact but keeps watching from a distance, causing confusion.

relacionamentos.significado: When the person who ghosted you (disappeared) suddenly reappears acting like nothing happened, with needy messages or reacting to posts.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: Three months after disappearing, he texted me 'I miss you.' That's zombieing, and I ignored it.
exemplos_incorretos: We learned a new zombieing dance move at the electronic music party yesterday.
He's zombieing me, he just likes my stories, never actually messages.
He disappeared for good, is that zombieing? I thought that was just ghosting.
significados_incorretos: A popular dance style at electronic music parties.
Liking someone's stories without ever sending a message.
Disappearing for good and never giving any sign of life again.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes the sudden reappearance of someone who abandoned contact without explanation, which tends to cause discomfort and distrust.

relacionamentos.significado: Used to describe a man who has no standout qualities, puts in little effort, and doesn't add value to the relationship.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I don't know what Maria sees in him, the guy doesn't work or study, he's a total deadbeat.
exemplos_incorretos: The deadbeat showed up in a bank commercial on TV yesterday.
He's a deadbeat, super sweet, just doesn't have any money.
He's a deadbeat because he works too much and never has time for her.
significados_incorretos: A fictional character used in bank commercials.
A sweet man who just doesn't have much money.
A man who works a lot and never has time for the relationship.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because the term is used pejoratively to call out a lack of effort, merit, or value from a partner in a relationship.

relacionamentos.significado: Someone who does everything to please someone romantically in an exaggerated, submissive way, losing their dignity in exchange for the desired person's attention.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: She doesn't even look at him, but he keeps buying her lunch, such a simp.
exemplos_incorretos: The team's simp went to the stadium with face paint, screaming the whole game.
He's a simp, he agrees with everything his girlfriend says, even after ten years together.
He's just polite and treats her well, that's not simping, that's just respect.
significados_incorretos: A nickname for a die-hard sports fan.
Someone who always agrees with what their partner says, even in a serious relationship.
Someone who treats their partner well out of politeness and respect, with no excess.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes excessive submission and a loss of self-respect in trying to please someone, seen as harmful to self-esteem.

relacionamentos.significado: Short for 'delusional.' Describes someone who builds unrealistic romantic fantasies in their head, believing in a relationship that has no real chance of happening.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: He liked my photo, we're definitely getting married, I'm so delulu today.
exemplos_incorretos: I downloaded delulu to edit my photos before posting.
She believed every empty promise he made, so delulu of her.
It's not delulu, he's already introduced me to his family, it's the real deal.
significados_incorretos: A photo-editing app for social media.
Believing too much in someone's empty promises.
Being sure of a serious relationship based on real, clear signs.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Depends on context because it can be a fond joke between friends or a criticism of someone deluding themselves about a situation with no real chance.

relacionamentos.significado: Older slang (still in use) for someone who shows romantic interest in another person only because of their vehicle or material possessions.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: The moment he bought a fancy car she started paying attention to him, total gold digger.
exemplos_incorretos: The gold digger was a famous dancer who was a hit in the 90s.
She only goes out with guys who have a car, she's kind of a gold digger about that.
She just looks for financial stability in a partner, that's not really being a gold digger.
significados_incorretos: A famous dancer's nickname from the 90s.
Someone who only dates people who own a car.
Someone who values financial stability in a partner.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it accuses the person of only being interested in material things, reducing the relationship to financial interest.

relacionamentos.significado: A sign of good behavior or a positive trait in someone's character that shows maturity and potential for a healthy relationship.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: He always listens closely and supports my projects, that's a huge green flag.
exemplos_incorretos: The referee raised the green flag to stop the soccer match.
She's super jealous and checks all my messages, huge green flag.
I bought a green flag to put on the flagpole in the backyard.
significados_incorretos: A signal used by referees in sports matches.
Possessive, controlling behavior in a relationship.
A fabric flag used to decorate outdoor areas.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it signals healthy, desirable qualities in a partner, encouraging more mature relationships.

relacionamentos.significado: A romantic or sexual involvement with no clear definition or formal commitment, somewhere between a friendship and a relationship.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: We've been seeing each other for six months but nobody's labeled it, we're in a real situationship.
exemplos_incorretos: I signed a situationship at the bank to get a loan.
They got legally married last week, they're living a situationship.
I bought a new situationship to fix the car's flat tire.
significados_incorretos: A financial contract to obtain a bank loan.
A legally registered civil marriage.
An automotive tool for tire repair.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Depends on context because it can be experienced as something light and pressure-free, but can also cause frustration from the lack of definition and commitment.

relacionamentos.significado: Sending sporadic, minimal signs of interest (likes, short texts) just to keep someone interested with no intention of building anything serious.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: He only texts every once in a while so I don't forget him, he's breadcrumbing me.
exemplos_incorretos: I did some breadcrumbing on the chicken before frying it in the kitchen.
She proposed to me with a ring, pure breadcrumbing.
He disappeared and never replied again, that's a classic case of breadcrumbing.
significados_incorretos: A cooking technique for coating food before frying.
A formal marriage proposal with an exchange of rings.
Disappearing and completely cutting off contact.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes subtly manipulating someone into staying interested with minimal effort, with no intention of real commitment.

relacionamentos.significado: Posting a photo with a new partner on social media in a subtle, mysterious way (like just a hand or a back view), without revealing their identity.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: She posted a photo of two wine glasses and his hand, that was her boyfriend's soft launch.
exemplos_incorretos: The rocket did a soft launch on its way to space.
She posted a clear photo of his face and tagged his profile, quite the soft launch.
A soft launch is when you break up with someone over social media.
significados_incorretos: Launching space rockets.
Posting an explicit photo tagging a partner's profile.
Ending a romantic relationship through social media.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it describes a gentle, subtle way of sharing romantic news, respecting the couple's own pace.

relacionamentos.significado: Openly and directly making a relationship public on social media, posting a clear photo of the couple and tagging their profile.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: After months of hiding it, she did the hard launch, posting a photo of them kissing.
exemplos_incorretos: The ship did a hard launch at the city's port.
She did a hard launch posting just a mysterious shadow on the ground.
A hard launch is when two people decide to just be friends.
significados_incorretos: Ships docking at seaports.
Posting only mysterious clues or shadows without showing the person.
Transitioning from a romantic relationship to a friendship.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Positive because it marks the moment of publicly and confidently committing to a relationship in a transparent way.

relacionamentos.significado: Keeping someone as a backup option, maintaining just enough contact so they don't walk away while you look for other options.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: I feel like I'm being benched, he only calls me when all his other plans fall through.
exemplos_incorretos: I did some benching at the gym, lifting a hundred kilos on the bench press.
He made things official with me in the first month, a perfect benching.
I put a wooden bench on the porch to sit on.
significados_incorretos: A weightlifting exercise done on a bench.
Making a serious romantic commitment in the first month.
A wooden bench used as garden furniture.
relacionamentos.impacto_motivo: Negative because it describes the practice of keeping someone as a backup plan, which disregards and disrespects the other person.

relacionamentos.significado: Keeping casual hookups active while already in a relationship, to guarantee options in case the current relationship ends.
relacionamentos.exemplo_correto: He keeps texting and flirting with an ex while dating someone else, that's cushioning.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a feather cushioning for the couch.
Cushioning is when you devote 100% of yourself to your partner and talk to no one else.
I adjusted the cushioning in my shoe to walk more comfortably.
significados_incorretos: A feather pillow used to decorate a living room.
Being fully loyal and devoted only to your current partner.
